stages.name: Tech Stack, Design, Plan & Approval Gate

steps.title: Instant-Ack waiting notice, Requirement Engineering (FR/NFR/Acceptance Criteria), tier classification (Get-SenTaskRiskScore), Singleton Office Tab check (Get-SenOfficeTabStatus) & 4-Signal Target Collision Queue (Test-SenTargetCollision, Register-SenTaskQueue)
5-Layer Tech Stack Discovery/Advisory (Get-SenProjectTechStack), Dialectical Proof, Critique & Resource Cost column (Best-of-the-Best, Invoke-SenDialecticalAudit) & Approval-First Gate
Write technical Design Spec (docs/superpowers/specs/*.md), API Contract / DB Schema & Phase 1 Output Simulation (Write-SenOfficeShowcase)

Execute tasks across Testing Pyramid (Unit/Integration/Smoke) with verified test evidence (ExitCode = 0), Bounded Repair Loop (Invoke-SenBoundedRepairRound / Invoke-SenEscalationQuarantine, .agents/office/bounded-loops.json) & zero hung tasks (Test-SenHungTasks)
Two-way sync [x] checkboxes in plans/*.md and docs/TODO.md

Sync docs/CONTEXT.md & TODO.md/README/CHANGELOG (Test-SenCapabilityParity), state seal & Git hooks (Sync-SenOfficeState, Install-SenGitHooks), Phase 2 Output Simulation (Write-SenOfficeShowcase), Runbook/delivery report & CI push loop (Invoke-SenCiPushLoop)
